title: Flashcards: Birds, families
intro: Flip each card about birds. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: To which family does the African Jacana (Actophilornis africanus) belong?
cards.explain: The African Jacana belongs to the family Jacanidae.

cards.front: To which family does the mallard (Anas platyrhynchos) belong?
cards.explain: The mallard belongs to the family Anatidae.

cards.front: To which family does the greater white-fronted goose (Anser albifrons) belong?
cards.explain: The greater white-fronted goose belongs to the family Anatidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Trumpeter Swan (Cygnus buccinator) belong?
cards.explain: The Trumpeter Swan belongs to the family Anatidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Bronzed Drongo (Dicrurus aeneus) belong?
cards.explain: The Bronzed Drongo belongs to the family drongo.

cards.front: To which family does the Verditer Flycatcher (Eumyias thalassinus) belong?
cards.explain: The Verditer Flycatcher belongs to the family Muscicapidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Red Fody (Foudia madagascariensis) belong?
cards.explain: The Red Fody belongs to the family Ploceidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Guam Rail (Gallirallus owstoni) belong?
cards.explain: The Guam Rail belongs to the family Rallidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Greater Roadrunner (Geococcyx californianus) belong?
cards.explain: The Greater Roadrunner belongs to the family Cuculidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Asian Dowitcher (Limnodromus semipalmatus) belong?
cards.explain: The Asian Dowitcher belongs to the family Scolopacidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Morepork (Ninox novaeseelandiae) belong?
cards.explain: The Morepork belongs to the family true owls.

cards.front: To which family does the Crested Serpent Eagle (Spilornis cheela) belong?
cards.explain: The Crested Serpent Eagle belongs to the family Accipitridae.

cards.front: To which family does the Long-tailed Jaeger (Stercorarius longicaudus) belong?
cards.explain: The Long-tailed Jaeger belongs to the family Stercorariidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Altai Snowcock (Tetraogallus altaicus) belong?
cards.explain: The Altai Snowcock belongs to the family Phasianidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Red-eyed Vireo (Vireo olivaceus) belong?
cards.explain: The Red-eyed Vireo belongs to the family Vireonidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Mourning Dove (Zenaida macroura) belong?
cards.explain: The Mourning Dove belongs to the family Columbidae.
